frontend.reason: Configurator and Admin screens stay on existing CRM routes; this contract covers host/proxy/schema cutover.

notes: Live catalog API and fair_stand_* data move to the Fair Stand process and fair_stand database. CRM Alembic 0089 drops leftover fair_crm.fair_stand_* tables. Vite/Nginx proxy /api/v1/fair-stand/ to :8002. Historical CRM migrations 0084-0088 remain for upgrade history; leftover seed modules exist only for those revisions.
